Azeroth Survivors Blade Flurry Rogue for Elwynn Endless

Last updated: November 11, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

eglise’s plan targets a solo 40-minute Endless attempt in normal Elwynn Forest. It uses Darkmantle Tier 0.5 and 32 Assassination, 1 Combat and 18 Subtlety. The goal and difficulty are useful when deciding whether this setup fits your run.

Check the six slots

The planner has Blade Flurry, Eviscerate, Ghostly Strike, Sinister Strike, Adrenaline Rush and Slice and Dice. Keep space for the complete lineup as you draft. The shared plan gives the starting loadout and final talent allocation; choose rank-ups based on the pack you are failing to clear and your ability to stay in motion.

Separate clearing from survival

What to compareHow to use the plan
Blade Flurry and EviscerateCheck whether a failed attempt lost control of the pack or stalled on a tougher target. That tells you which part of the loadout to examine first.
Darkmantle setReview the equipped set and its Marked for Death effect before comparing it with a different armor set.
Two defensive jewelry slotsThe plan pairs Archimtiros’ Ring of Reckoning with Star of Mystaria, leaving the other ring and trinket slots for offensive choices.

Record the Endless attempt

Keep Elwynn, Normal and the elapsed survival time in your notes. If you try the same talents in Heroic or another zone, record that separately so the result stays comparable. The planner describes a 40-minute target and does not document a recorded clear.
